name: Worn Grey Ruins
descriptions: A room of worn grey brick that has seen the passage of many adventurers.
You enter a long grey corridor, its walls lined with crumbling stone.
Low grey arches divide this chamber into uneven halves.
A square chamber of rough-cut grey stone, its floor worn smooth by countless boots.
The corridor narrows here, the grey walls leaning in as if tired of standing.
A wide hall stretches ahead, broken columns of grey stone marking where a roof once stood.
This small room is little more than a gap between collapsed walls of grey brick.
Faded carvings cover the grey walls of this chamber, worn too far to read.
A long gallery of grey stone opens before you, empty alcoves set into both walls.
Half of this room has fallen in, leaving a slope of grey rubble against the far wall.
A round chamber of grey stone rises to a cracked dome overhead.
Steps lead down into a sunken grey room, their edges rounded by age.
You pass through a doorway with no door into a bare chamber of grey brick.
Grey flagstones, many cracked or missing, cover the floor of this cramped passage.
A tall, narrow room of grey stone, its upper walls lost in shadow.
highlights: A light smell of sulfur draws your attention to a series of scorch marks, as if someone practiced a fire spell here again and again.
There's a faint smell of mold in the air.
Garbage has piled up in the corners near the walls.
Water drips steadily somewhere in the dark, each drop echoing off the stone.
A cold draft brushes past you from a crack in the wall, carrying the smell of damp earth.
The stone underfoot is slick and faintly sticky, as if something wet passed through not long ago.
A rusted sword lies snapped in two near the doorway, its hilt wrapped in rotted leather.
Somewhere above, small claws scrabble across the stone, then stop.
The air here is noticeably warmer, and smells faintly of smoke.
Someone has scratched a tally of marks into the wall, then given up partway through a row.
A sour, musky odor hangs in the air, strongest near a heap of droppings.
Faint chalk arrows on the floor point back the way you came.
A low hum seems to come from the stones themselves, felt more than heard.
Your footsteps sound strangely muffled, as if the room is swallowing the noise.
The ashes of an old campfire sit in a ring of stones, long cold.
Thick cobwebs drape the ceiling, swaying gently though you feel no breeze.
A dusty, dry smell fills the room, like old parchment left too long in the sun.
A broken lantern hangs from a hook on the wall, its glass long since shattered.
Gnawed bones are scattered across the floor, too small to be human.
The air tastes of metal, and the hair on your arms stands on end.
A thin trickle of water runs along a groove in the floor and disappears under the wall.
Bits of torn cloth are caught on a jagged stone near the floor, stained a dark brown.
stairs_description: A narrow stair of worn grey stone spirals down into the dark. Cooler air drifts up from below.
boss_door_description: A heavy door of iron-banded oak blocks the way forward, set deep into a wall of grey stone. Deep gouges score its surface, and the air beyond feels still and waiting.
